text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan's victory sent the crowd into 
a frenzy. Battles along the Classic Triple 
Crown road are always so thrilling...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And having tasted the allure of the grand 
stage once, it held her heart captive and 
refused to let go. Even though her hooves 
were already overworked and in a dreadful 
state...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan voices her heartfelt plea to 
keep running. The doctor and Trainer take 
action to fully heal her hooves for her 
sake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What awaited Tosen Jordan was an article 
praising her grit for never giving up even 
in hardship, along with gyaru Umamusume 
inspired by it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Flattered after being praised as the "Star 
of Gals," she blushed. Let's make sure her 
hooves are fully healed by the next 
target, the autumn GII Copa Republica 
Argentina, and keep running together with 
her.
